Safe RLHF（Dai 等，北京大学 PKU-Alignment，arXiv 2023-10，ICLR 2024）：有用与有害分开打分（奖励模型 / 代价模型），在代价约束下最大化奖励，用拉格朗日方法在微调中动态调整两者平衡；超标时 λ 升、守住时 λ 降
claims.source: Dai et al., Safe RLHF: Safe Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, arXiv:2310.12773；ICLR 2024 spotlight
claims.quote: Leveraging the Lagrangian method to solve this constrained problem, Safe RLHF dynamically adjusts the balance between the two objectives during fine-tuning.
